headline: Exchanges Took In $109 Million of Bitcoin as the Price Slipped to 83k
narrative: Exchanges took in about $109 million of bitcoin in the latest day, a turn from an outflow of about $72.5 million. The exchange pipe is distribution: balances are higher by 17,677 bitcoin over seven days, coins sitting where holders can sell. Bitcoin slipped to 83k, down 0.35 percent, while the spot pipe stayed buy-side leaning, with cumulative volume delta at the 77.4 percentile of its 30-day range.
author: jordan
